title: APKRun Direct provider manifest, schema version 1
description: Structure of the manifest that a distributor publishes over HTTPS for the APKRun DirectProvider. This schema is normative for structure. docs/03-reference/direct-provider-manifest.md is normative for semantics (URL resolution, size sums, uniqueness, error mapping). Unknown properties are allowed and ignored by readers.

schemaVersion.description: Format version of this manifest. Only 1 is defined.

packageId.description: Android package name. Must equal the installed package (checked by the reader).

versionCode.description: Android longVersionCode of the release (versionCodeMajor in the high 32 bits).

artifacts.description: The files of the release: one base APK with optional splits, or one .apks container alone.

oneOf.description: Exactly one base APK, any number of splits, no container.
Exactly one .apks container and nothing else.

signingCertificates.description: SHA-256 digests of the DER signing certificates of the release's signer set. Compared with the downloaded APK after the download (V5).

minSdk.description: Declared minSdkVersion of the release. A pre-filter only; the APK decides (I8).

releaseNotes.description: Plain text release notes. Never rendered as HTML. At most 16 KiB of UTF-8 (the reader also checks the byte length).

publishedAt.description: Release time, RFC 3339 with a time zone.

sha256Hex.description: SHA-256 of a file as 64 hex digits. Readers normalize to lower case.

certificateDigest.description: SHA-256 of a DER certificate in the APKRun digest form.

splitName.description: Android split name, for example config.arm64_v8a or feature_camera.

type.description: apk = the base APK, split = one split APK, apks = a bundletool .apks container.

url.description: Absolute https URL, or a reference relative to the manifest URL. Must be https after resolution.

size.description: Size in bytes. Optional. When present, a download that grows beyond it is stopped.
